about: Lists of providers found for the Boise (Potential) office, Boise, Idaho (planned Transitional Services Office; address not yet known; 83706 centre, provisionally 20 miles: Boise, Garden City, Meridian, Kuna, Eagle, Star and Nampa in reach; Caldwell, Middleton and Emmett just beyond), by the publisher playbook of resource-discovery-design.md 6.1, on 14 October 2026. Home counties: Ada and Canyon. Read together with states/idaho.json (statewide Idaho lists) and federal.json (national locators, each tested for Boise's 83702), which are not repeated here. No state line is in reach. Lists only: no providers were harvested or checked, and no office-fit rules applied. namesFound is a rough count where the page text showed it. Pages that returned 403 or 406 are marked refused; where the Internet Archive held a copy of such a page, the copy was read and the note says so (the live address may differ from the copy). Where only search-result text was available the note says so. A list covering Canyon County only belongs here. Two lists dominate: the Ada County and Canyon County Self Rescue Manuals, 19-category directories of about 490 and 300 phone numbers, both old (2021 and 2018) and both read only from archive copies because their live hosts are blocked or gone; a newer edition is the first thing to ask Boise School District's social workers for.

gaps.food: Plenty of lists, none official for Ada and Canyon together: Plentiful (Boise 31, Nampa 12, Caldwell 12, Kuna also), Feed America (54 Boise), Boise Mom, Nampa city page (archived Dec 2023), both Self Rescue Manuals, Garden City page. The authoritative state finder (Health and Welfare, 290 sites) is a search form, so the Ada and Canyon rows were not extracted. Meridian, Eagle and Star have no list of their own; Eagle Community Foodbank and Meridian Food Bank were named only in search results.
gaps.housing: Housing authorities (Boise City/Ada County, Nampa, Caldwell, SICHA) are on the county and CWI lists but no page of their own was read for Ada. Waiting-list status comes from aggregators with conflicting dates. Our Path Home and Idaho Housing (Region 3 Access Point, CATCH) are the entry points; the Idaho Housing Region 3 request-for-proposal and the 2021 HMIS list returned 404 or are stale.
gaps.homeless-services: Strong for Ada (Homeless Coalition pocket guide dated 5/2026, Our Path Home); thin for Canyon: the county page, the Canyon Self Rescue Manual (2018) and the 2022 HMIS list. The Coalition's meals calendar and Our Path Home partner list were not read.
gaps.mental-health: Region 3 crisis brochure (Jan 2021) and Region 4 BHB resources page are short; no current directory of counsellors for Ada or Canyon. NAMI Idaho returned a 403. IdaHope directory named in a search result was not reached.
gaps.addiction: SobaSearch (105 Boise meetings), the two Self Rescue Manuals, the state's crisis and recovery community centre pages. The state's own Idaho Treatment and Recovery Support Resource Map is 'under construction'. A Treasure Valley AA site named in an old news item does not connect.
gaps.medical-dental-vision: No Ada or Canyon directory of free clinics read first-hand: Genesis Community Health, Care House Nampa, Terry Reilly and Full Circle Health appear on the CWI safety-net page; Saint Alphonsus's directory is behind a 403; the Idaho health-centre finder is a form. Vision has almost nothing beyond the Self Rescue Manuals.
gaps.legal: Idaho Legal Aid (403) and the Idaho Volunteer Lawyers Program clinics (Boise main library first Tuesdays, Nampa library) are known from search results and pages that are statewide; the Ada Court Assistance Office page was read. No list of immigration or family-law clinics with current dates.
gaps.domestic-violence: Reasonable: Nampa Family Justice Center partner list (27), ICDV statewide table, parole board page, Ada victim-witness page. Hope's Door and Valley Women and Children's Shelter appear in several lists, none with a bed count.
gaps.children-pregnancy: Idaho Diaper Bank locations (about 30 sites), Diocese of Boise pregnancy centre list (one point of view), Macaroni Kid directories; no Head Start, WIC clinic or child-care referral list for Ada/Canyon read first-hand (Child Care Aware returned 403).
gaps.clothing-household: Only the two Self Rescue Manuals (2021 and 2018), Garden City's page and the Boise pocket guide. Everything else came from search snippets (thrift stores, Agape in Action, The Closet). No furniture-bank list.
gaps.disability: LINC (ILRU directory), Region pages and the Self Rescue Manuals; Idaho Parents Unlimited, DisAbility Rights Idaho and the Arc are known only from search results; no Ada/Canyon adult-services directory.
gaps.seniors: The Southwest AAA (Meridian) site, the Canyon page, Seniors Blue Book (ad-supported); the state's senior centres list returned 404; the Nampa Elder Resource Guide returned 404 in the archive and 403 live.
gaps.veterans: The Treasure Valley Joining Forces guide is 'under revision' and not posted; the state 2021 directory is the current statewide one; Warriors Fund and Boise State pages are aggregators.
gaps.employment: Idaho Dept of Labor and Vocational Rehabilitation pages, CWI, Garden City list; no local list of employers who hire people with records or a Treasure Valley job-club directory. The Labor Department's 2024 reentry guide URL is dead (2020 edition read, statewide file).
gaps.education: CWI adult education (Boise and Nampa) and the Self Rescue Manuals; the Learning Lab and Boise School District adult education were not read; no ESL directory.
gaps.financial-assistance: Canyon County one-pager (2023), CWI and Garden City pages, Ada County indigent services page, VITA. No Ada County list of rent-assistance providers beyond Jesse Tree and El-Ada, and Idaho Power or Intermountain Gas current programmes were seen only in search results and the City of Boise page.
gaps.utilities-phone-internet: City of Boise bill help, Canyon list, Garden City page. Lifeline and the Idaho phone discount are federal and state programmes, not local lists (the PUC factsheet did not load). Nothing on digital inclusion in Ada or Canyon libraries.
gaps.transportation: VRT's own pages (routes, services, Rides2Wellness) are good; Medicaid ride broker (MTM) and Area Agency on Aging rides were seen only in search results; no list of volunteer driver or church ride programmes.
gaps.reentry-support: No county or city reentry guide for Ada or Canyon found. IDOC reentry centres and district offices (statewide file), a third-party directory (HelpForFelons, April 2026) and St. Vincent de Paul's reentry programme (search result) are what exist. The Ada County Sheriff's Community Transition Center has no published guide. See requests.
gaps.id-recovery: Not a list category: the ITD free-ID procedure (statewide file) names the steps (form 3530 completed by a shelter or relief agency; one free birth certificate); no Boise page listing where people get help with the paperwork was found. Social Security office locator is federal.
gaps.immigration: Immigration Advocates directory lists 7 Idaho organisations (statewide file); the Idaho Office for Refugees site was not read; the Idaho Commission on Hispanic Affairs referral list found (2017/18) was not reachable and is stale. No Spanish-language community directory found.
